entries.name: 정제용 빙어
entries.description: 맑은 몸에 옅은 기름빛이 비치는 작은 빙어. 내다 팔 값은 낮지만, 잘 모으면 배를 움직일 무언가가 나올지도 모릅니다.
entries.thumbnail_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production game collectible thumbnail: a tiny translucent ice-blue smelt fish, slender short body, clearly visible silvery backbone, large glossy dark eye, tiny pale amber belly reservoir, forked transparent tail. Side profile with HEAD pointing RIGHT, tail LEFT. Common rarity, simple inexpensive fish, charming rounded cartoon proportions, dark brown clean outline and soft shaded cel colors consistent with attached STYLE reference. Reference is STYLE ONLY; no otter, fur, hook, starfish. One whole fish centered, occupies 82% of width, generous transparent margin. No text, no scene, no bubbles, no checkerboard. Genuine alpha transparent background.
entries.sprite_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve game animation. The reference image is the EXACT fish identity. Create a 2 by 2 FOUR-frame seamless swimming sprite sheet, precisely equal SQUARE cells, square total canvas. Every cell contains ONE whole identical a tiny translucent ice-blue smelt fish, slender short body, clearly visible silvery backbone, large glossy dark eye, tiny pale amber belly reservoir, forked transparent tail. Head RIGHT, tail LEFT in all cells, horizontal side profile. Frame order row-major: neutral tail; tail smoothly flexes slightly toward viewer; neutral tail with trailing fins; tail flexes slightly away from viewer. Keep rigid HEAD/EYE/BODY center, body size and eye position identical relative to each cell. Natural small tail propulsion and subtle fin water response; no big side fin paddling, no body squash or vertical jumps, no eye-only frames. Preserve exact reference colors/anatomy/outline. Each fish occupies 80-84% of cell width. At least 8% transparent margin around EVERY cell; do not cross center seams; tail and nose always fully included. Genuine transparent alpha background, no grid, text, borders, scene, bubbles, shadows or extra fish. Four clearly distinct tail/fin poses, clean warm shaded cartoon.
